blocks.text: PARIS, France — France’s culture ministry announced that several Paris museums including the Louvre would be closed Saturday, when officials fear more looting on the margins of a new round of protests. The Orsay museum, which houses 19th-century art including the Impressionists, and the Picasso museum are among the other venues affected, said a ministry statement. French authorities on Thursday imposed bans or restrictions on fresh protests springing up in the wake of demonstrations last weekend that degenerated into the country’s worst street violence in years.
